comment_data.body:
'mini.hues' does not and will not support transparency out of the box. It can mostly be achieved by setting background attribute to `NONE` in some common highlight groups (like `Normal`, `SignColumn`, etc.).

My suggestion would indeed be to use 'mini.colors' and its [`add_transparency()` method](https://github.com/echasnovski/mini.nvim/blob/f40da50a3dfbbc53e6173beef8dc28626e1b5ebc/doc/mini-colors.txt#L409) for color scheme. So basically:
- Execute `require('mini.hues').setup(...)` to get the color scheme you'd like.
- Execute `require('mini.colors').get_colorscheme():add_transparency():write({ name = 'mine' })` (use argument for `add_transparency()` to adjust which highlight groups you want to make transparent) and it will add '~/.config/nvim/colors/mine.lua' color scheme file which you can later use via `:colorscheme mine`.
